label: prop:borromean-h4-categorical-derivation
title: Borromean $h^4 = -3/4$ derived as $(-3) \cdot (1/4)$ via R-matrix + Markov normalisation
html:
The h^4 coefficient of the Borromean Markov trace \mathrm{tr}_M(\beta_{\mathrm{Bor}}) = (4 + h^2 - 3h^4 - h^6)/(h^2 + 4) factorises as

  \boxed{\;\;
  \bigl[h^4\text{-coeff of } \mathrm{tr}_M(\beta_{\mathrm{Bor}})\bigr]
  \;=\;
  \underbrace{(-3)}_{\chi^{(2,1)}\text{ from R-matrix}}
  \;\cdot\;
  \underbrace{\tfrac{1}{4}}_{[2]_q^{-2}|_{q=1}\text{ Markov norm.}}
  \;=\;
  -\tfrac{3}{4},
  \;\;}

where -3 is the h^4 coefficient of the S_3 standard-irrep character \chi^{(2,1)}(\beta_{\mathrm{Bor}}) = 2 - 3h^4 - h^6, derived from the U_q(\mathfrak{sl}_2) R-matrix on V_{1/2}^{\otimes 3} via Schur–Weyl duality; and 1/4 = 1/[2]_q^2|_{q=1} is the standard Markov-trace normalisation for c = 3-component link closure.

The connection to the wider framework and the significance of the factorisation are collected in the Borromean h^4 context.

Archimedean specialisation. The factor 1/4 = [2]_q^{-2}\big|_{q=1} is the archimedean q = 1 numerical evaluation of the exact Wenzl weight; the companion Lean states the rational factorisation (-3)\cdot(1/4) = -3/4 over \mathbb{R}, on the archimedean side of the substrate wall.
